displayName: TAAMs 수입식품·농산물 경매 (Korea Food Trade Data)
description: 한국 식품의약품안전처(MFDS) 수입식품 통관 데이터와 전국 32개 도매시장 농수산물 경매 낙찰가를 조회한다 — 수입단가·통관실적·수입사/수출사·시장별 경매시세·산지 기상. 조회 전용 도구 19종. Search South Korea food import customs data (MFDS) and Korean wholesale market auction prices: import unit prices in USD/kg, clearance records, Korean importers, overseas exporters, daily auction prices from 32 wholesale markets including Seoul Garak, and origin weather. 19 read-only tools via a remote MCP server.
